judged_text: Migration inserts legacy embeddable_hosts setting values verbatim into the new table, bypassing the model's before_validation normalization; the old allows_embeddable_host? stripped http(s)://, so protocol-prefixed entries like 'http://eviltrout.com' were previously supported, but they can never match the new where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host) lookup, causing previously-allowed embed sites to silently receive 403 Discourse::InvalidAccess ('invalid referer host') after upgrade with no error surfaced anywhere.
